text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: It was a wondrous moment.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
When the three converged near the finish,
they each wanted time to
stop right there.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
But as if her fate was guided by the alpha
star inscribed in her name, the racer in
blue crossed the finish line, spelling the
end of that
moment.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The name of that star was Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Their goal should have been to cross that
line quickly, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
If it were possible,
they would have stayed
racing in their shared
moment forever.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
The battle of the Classics has come at
last.
Leading off is the first
race in the series,
the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Today we have with us the first, second
and third favorites to win the
race. It's the
trio on everyone's lips, BNW!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... I'm so nervous it's making me
itchy...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm not used to you being so quiet. It's making me nervous!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Deep breaths... nice and slow.

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
I'd now like to begin today's press
conference with the runners of the
Satsuki
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I understand that the three of you are
good friends. How do you feel
facing each
other in the same race?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When we entered the academy, we talked
about racing together.
Now that the time's
finally here, it's rather exciting.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Um... Same for me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, me too! Put me down as samesies with
Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: C-copycats...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
The public has endearingly dubbed the
three of you "BNW". Leading into the
Classics,
what would you like to say to the
public?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You two go first this time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: After you, Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wha, me?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uh... The... the BWH trio is gonna make it
big!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't "BWH" a set of measurements?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gaaaaagh! I messed it up!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen such a botched press
conference.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, sometimes we have to let Ticket do
her thing.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm still SO embarrassed just thinking about it!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ah! It's BNW!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
We just saw your press conference! You're
such a joker, Tickezo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I didn't do it on purpose!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
You were amazing in the Yayoi Sho! I
turned into a total Tickezo fan
after that!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Thanks! Keep watching, I'm
gonna win the Satsuki Sho too!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Um, do you think I could get your
autographs?!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Me too, please!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, fine with you two, right? I just got
used to signing my name!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Phew, that was a lot of signing!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's finally calmed down. I didn't think a
crowd could form so quickly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
And now we see who's most popular. You
were signing nonstop, huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I dunno if I'm happy or embarrassed...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But every year, over a hundred thousand
fans show up to see the
Derby, you know?
I gotta be able to sign like the wind!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry? Don't tell me you're gonna give
autographs to a hundred
thousand people.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I know it's impossible,
but I wish I could.
Even in that press
conference, I felt like I
couldn't let all those people down.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
For all the autographs I can't sign,
I gotta
give them a race that'll
make them really
happy!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, sometimes you say some poignant
things.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Oh, yeah! You two wanna take
some photos together to turn
into
stickers?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We're about to start the Classics, so it'd
be like a sign of our
determination!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Seems like kind of a weird way to show
that...  But sure, why not?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look, look! This booth makes faces
look smaller! You're always
worried about
how big your head is, right, Hayahide?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I worry about the abundance of my hair!
Not the size of my head!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, was that it? Whatever! Check it
out—you can write stuff on the
pics, so
let's put "Derby" on there!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Why "Derby"?! The next race is the Satsuki
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Come on, it'll be fun! We're gonna
race through the Classics
togetheeer!
